name: Nekketsu Inou Bukatsu-tan Trigger Kiss
original_name: 熱血異能部活譚 Trigger Kiss
source:
2083 AD.
Akizuki High’s Superpower Club accomplishes their first victory and dominated the nationwide competition. However, the joy was only momentary. Due to a violent incident involving members of the Superpower Club right after the tournament, they were punished by getting their win revoked and banned from conducting club abilities for two years.

…From then on, two years pass.
Upon receiving the previously sealed-away key to the Superpower Club’s room, the club’s captain, Kanzaki Azuma, is given a heartless ultimatum by the school’s principal.

“If the Superpower Club does not dominate all competition in the coming tournament, I’ll have it abolished.”

That was the secret agreement made in the past between Azuma and the principal.

However, the only ones left in the Superpower Club were two members- Azuma himself and the Vice Captain Subaru Yamato. They had no time to worry about completely dominating the competition, as the real issue is the fact that they didn’t even have the minimum amount of required members. Even so, Azuma replied seemingly confident.

“I’ll get it done.”

At the same time, a transfer student arrives. The second-year girl’s name was Sendou Futaba. Unexpectedly, Futaba’s mother is a member of the U.N.-supervised “R8″; a group whose members are composed of the strongest superpowered people. Azuma, seeing her as the last resort for the club’s continuation, headed towards her classroom…

…Without knowing how much she really hates superpower clubs.

[Translation of the official website's story summary.]
translation:
西元2083年。
秋月高中超能力社首次獲勝，並稱霸全國大賽。然而，喜悅只持續了片刻。大賽結束後，超能力社成員捲入暴力事件，因此受到懲罰：取消比賽成績，並禁止社團活動兩年。

……兩年後。
超能力社社長神崎東收到那把此前被封存的社辦鑰匙，同時也從校長那裡得到冷酷的最後通牒。

「如果超能力社不能在即將舉行的大賽中稱霸所有項目，我就解散它。」

這是東與校長過去達成的秘密約定。

然而，超能力社只剩兩名成員——東本人和副社長大和昴。他們根本沒時間擔心能否稱霸比賽，因為更實際的問題是，社團甚至沒有達到規定的最低人數。即便如此，東還是自信地回答：

「交給我吧。」

與此同時，一名轉學生到來。她是二年級女生，名叫千堂雙葉。出人意料的是，雙葉的母親是受聯合國監管的「R8」成員；這是一個由最強超能力者組成的組織。東把她視為社團延續的最後希望，前往她的教室……

……卻不知道她究竟有多麼憎恨超能力社。

［譯自官方網站故事簡介］
